objective: Verify the candidate does not write beyond the logical region.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture the entire odata buffer.
pass_condition: Pass iff logical cells match the oracle bitwise and every element with x>=width remains bitwise equal to the sentinel.
setup: Pre-fill odata with a sentinel pattern across all pitch*height elements; use pitch>width; launch; compute host oracle for logical cells only.
